ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Find the perimeter of $\triangle A B C$
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended problem

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, vertex A of triangle ABC is at the upper left, C is at the lower left, and B is at the lower right; AC is a vertical side and is marked with length 10, and CB is a horizontal side; there is a right-angle marking at C, so ∠C is a right angle. AB is the hypotenuse. Point M is located on AB, segment CM connects from C to M, there is a right-angle marking at M, and CM is marked with length 6, so CM is the altitude from the right-angle vertex C to the hypotenuse AB. Reasoning: Let BC = x and AB = y. Use two representations of the area of the triangle: with AC and BC as the right-angle sides, the area is (1/2)·10·x; with AB as the base and CM as the height, the area is (1/2)·y·6. Thus 10x = 6y. Also because △ABC is right-angled at C, by the Pythagorean theorem y^2 = 10^2 + x^2. From 10x = 6y, obtain y = 5x/3. Substitute into the Pythagorean theorem: (5x/3)^2 = 100 + x^2, that is, 25x^2/9 = 100 + x^2, so 16x^2/9 = 100, x^2 = 56.25, x = 7.5. Thus y = 12.5. The perimeter is AC + BC + AB = 10 + 7.5 + 12.5 = 30.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify triangle ABC as right-angled at C, with AC labeled 10. Point M lies on side AB, and segment CM is drawn perpendicular to AB with length 6, so CM is the altitude from the right angle to the hypotenuse. Let BC = x and AB = y. Use the text request to compute the perimeter AC + BC + AB. Apply the right-triangle area relation using the two possible bases: (1/2)(AC)(BC) = (1/2)(AB)(CM), giving 10x = 6y. Also apply the Pythagorean theorem: y^2 = 10^2 + x^2. Solve these two equations to get x = 7.5 and y = 12.5, then add 10 + 7.5 + 12.5 = 30.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中，三角形ABC的顶点A在左上方，C在左下方，B在右下方；AC是竖直边并标有长度10，CB是水平边；C处有直角标记，所以∠C为直角。AB是斜边。点M位于AB上，线段CM从C连到M，M处有直角标记，且CM标有长度6，因此CM是从直角顶点C到斜边AB的高。
推理：设BC = x，AB = y。用三角形面积的两种表示：以AC和BC为直角边，面积为(1/2)·10·x；以AB为底、CM为高，面积为(1/2)·y·6。于是10x = 6y。又因为△ABC在C处为直角，由勾股定理得y^2 = 10^2 + x^2。由10x = 6y得y = 5x/3。代入勾股定理：(5x/3)^2 = 100 + x^2，即25x^2/9 = 100 + x^2，所以16x^2/9 = 100，x^2 = 56.25，x = 7.5。于是y = 12.5。周长为AC + BC + AB = 10 + 7.5 + 12.5 = 30。
